name: Three Card Poker
description: Three Card Poker is a popular casino table game based on poker. Players compete against the dealer. It features two modes of play: Ante/Play (playing against the dealer) and Pair Plus (betting on the hand value alone). It is known for its speed and simplicity.

history.origins: Three Card Poker was invented in England in the mid 1990s by Derek Webb. It was originally called Casino Brag, inspired by 3-card Brag, and was adapted so players bet against the house rather than each other. The name Three Card Poker was adopted when the game was introduced to America; it is also known as Tri Poker. Derek Webb's Prime Table Games marketed it to casinos; in 1999 Shuffle Master (later SHFL Entertainment) acquired the rights.

setup.dealing: 3 cards to each player and dealer.

rules.objective: Beat the dealer's hand with a higher 3-card poker hand.
rules.gameplay: 1. Ante bet (and optional Pair Plus). 2. Deal 3 cards. 3. Player decides to Play (match Ante) or Fold (lose Ante). 4. Dealer reveals hand. Dealer must qualify with Queen High or better. 5. Compare hands. Scoring: Straight Flush > Three of a Kind > Straight > Flush > Pair > High Card. (Note: Straight beats Flush in 3-card poker, usually).
keyRules: Three of a Kind beats Straight

strategy.basic: Simple optimal strategy: Play if you have Q-6-4 or better. Fold anything worse.
strategy.intermediate: Pair Plus is a high-variance bet with a house edge usually higher than Ante/Play.
strategy.advanced: Hole-carding (seeing dealer's card) can alter strategy slightly, but Q-6-4 is the mathematical baseline.
tips: Manage bankroll for Pair Plus variance.
